name: Return to Feathermoon Stronghold
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details: With the discovery of the strange gazebo in the heart of the Ruins of Solarsal, the time has come to return to Feathermoon Stronghold and report to General Shandris Feathermoon what has been discovered here.
narrative.objectives: Return to Shandris Feathermoon in the Feathermoon Stronghold and report your findings.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Welcome back, adventurer.  Your report on this gazebo is most... disturbing.  It would seem that even if the naga there were not planning on an attack, their continued presence bodes ill for our push into Feralas.  At any rate, here is compensation for your investigation.

It would seem that Feathermoon Stronghold is in dire need of additional assistance concerning the Hatecrest naga.  I'd like to offer you the task, if you are so inclined.  There is much to do.

chain.subtitle: 6 quests from level 43 to 45, 14,360 XP in all.

quests.name: The Ruins of Solarsal
quests.objectiveText: Explore the Ruins of Solarsal and investigate the presence of the naga there.

quests.name: Return to Feathermoon Stronghold
quests.objectiveText: Return to Shandris Feathermoon in the Feathermoon Stronghold and report your findings.

quests.name: Against the Hatecrest
quests.objectiveText: Report to Latronicus Moonspear in Feathermoon Stronghold.

quests.name: Against the Hatecrest
quests.objectiveText: Bring 10 Hatecrest Naga Scales to Latronicus Moonspear in Feathermoon Stronghold.

quests.name: Against Lord Shalzaru
quests.objectiveText: Eliminate Lord Shalzaru, and then bring the Mysterious Relic he uncovered to Latronicus Moonspear in Feathermoon Stronghold.

quests.name: Delivering the Relic
quests.objectiveText: Deliver the Mysterious Relic to Vestia Moonspear in Feathermoon Stronghold.
